title: OpenAI Baselines: ACKTR & A2C
summary: We’re releasing two new OpenAI Baselines implementations: ACKTR and A2C. A2C is a synchronous, deterministic variant of Asynchronous Advantage Actor Critic (A3C) which we’ve found gives equal performance. ACKTR is a more sample-efficient reinforcement learning algorithm than TRPO
reason: OpenAI announces a major update to its open-source OpenAI Baselines project, releasing new ACKTR and A2C implementations, with a link to the official announcement.
